patch_summary: Added safe_target_path() in keynote_parser/file_utils.py which strips drive letters, backslash separators, and '..'/'.'/empty/colon components from archive member names and verifies the realpath-resolved write path stays inside the target dir (skipping members that don't); dir_file_sink.accept() now routes all writes through it. Regression test tests/test_zip_slip.py committed separately first, then the fix.
root_cause: dir_file_sink.accept() joined attacker-controlled ZIP member names verbatim with os.path.join (which discards the base for absolute paths) and created parent dirs on the traversed path, allowing '../' and absolute-path members to write outside the output directory (CWE-22 zip-slip).
